title: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an algorithmic-complexity denial of service vulnerability in lib/exif_utils.js…
description: probe-image-size versions before 7.5.0 have an algorithmic-complexity denial of service vulnerability in the lib/exif_utils.js component. This flaw allows remote unauthenticated attackers to exhaust CPU resources by submitting specially crafted JPEG images with self-referencing EXIF IFD pointers, causing the Node.js event loop to block for approximately 23 seconds.
